samples.summary: applyBorderPatch's new delete path can destroy a spill ghost cell, breaking the invariant the calculator relies on
samples.evidence: The new code deletes the cell whenever `isEmptyCell(compactCell(cell, style))` is true (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4152-4155). `isEmptyCell` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/style-mutation.ts:48-52) only looks at value/formula/style — it ignores `spillAnchor`/`spillRows`/`spillCols`/`spillBlocked`. The calculator writes spill ghosts as `{ v: values[dr]?.[dc] ?? '', spillAnchor: sref }` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:141), i.e. a ghost can legitimately hold `v: ''`. Sequence: `setRangeBorders('all')` over a spill region stores `s:{bt:true,...}` on such a ghost; a following `setRangeBorders('clear')` prunes every border key, so `style` is undefined, `compactCell` yields `{ v: '', spillAnchor }`, `isEmptyCell` returns true, and `store.delete(anchor)` removes the ghost — orphaning the anchor's spill range with no recalculation triggered (setRangeBorders never calls `calculate`, unlike the checkbox path at sheet.ts:4048-4049). The diff's new spill test uses `v: '0'`, so this case is untested. The same latent gap exists in `setStyle` (sheet.ts:3723) and in the clear-formatting path (sheet.ts:4705), which the amended `compactCell` doc-comment now claims are spill-safe; the fix belongs either in `isEmptyCell` (treat spill fields as payload) or in the new delete guard.

samples.summary: Pruning an explicit border `false` is decided only at write time, so a later column/row/sheet border style now bleeds into cells the user explicitly cleared
samples.evidence: `pruneRedundantDefaultStyleKeys` drops `bt/bl/br/bb: false` when no conflicting layer exists *at the moment of the write* (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/style-mutation.ts:293-330, called from sheet.ts:4126). Any layer applied afterwards — e.g. `setRangeStyle({bt:true})` on a column selection, which writes into `colStyles` (sheet.ts:3746-3759) — is then inherited by cells whose border the user had explicitly cleared, because the masking `false` is no longer stored. `resolveEffectiveStyle` (used by `getStyle`, sheet.ts:3701-3705) and `gridcanvas` (packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1547) will render a border on those cells. This matches the existing range-style behaviour (docs/design/sheets/sheet-style.md:95-106 notes there is no 'explicitly none' token), so it may be intended, but it is a visible behaviour change for consumers of the stored/effective style.

verdict.reason: Every element of the claim checks out in the repository. sheet.ts:4152-4155 has the delete-on-empty path, and the early returns at 4145-4150 do not block the {bt:true,...} -> undefined transition. isEmptyCell (style-mutation.ts:48-52 with hasCellContent at 38-42) looks only at v/f/s and treats v==='' as no content, ignoring the spill fields that compactCell (style-mutation.ts:62-86) deliberately preserves and whose doc-comment (57-60) asserts spill safety. Ghosts can legitimately hold v:'' per calculator.ts:141. Nothing on the border path filters ghosts: setRangeBorders (4064-4088) -> collectBorderTargets (4160-4182) only normalizes merge anchors and has no spillAnchor check, in contrast to the explicit ghost read-only guards at sheet.ts:1041, 1119 and 4025; 'clear' prunes all four border keys via DefaultStyleValues (style-mutation.ts:20-32) leaving style undefined, so store.delete(anchor) removes the ghost. The deleted marker breaks an invariant other modules rely on: ownership-based ghost cleanup at calculator.ts:80, sheet.ts:1058 and sheet.ts:1133, and the read-only guard at sheet.ts:1041. setRangeBorders never triggers calculate, so nothing repairs the orphaned region. The same gap exists in setStyle (3722-3727) and the clear-formatting path (4704-4705). This is a violated cross-module invariant, which is explicitly in the blast-radius lane, so no refutation ground applies.
